name: HAM Club
description: RVCE Ham Club is the amateur radio club in RVCE. It was inaugurated on 27th August 2019. We aim to popularize Amateur Radio as a hobby among students while exploring technical innovations in the communication domain. RVCE HAM club shall have international collaborations with HAM units across the globe through its activities and aims to have talks with esteemed professionals across the globe through radio communication.

events.name: Step into Radiowaves with SDR
events.detail: Unleash the power of technology that turns your computer into a versatile radio receiver and transmitter.
